Fact.Name: Elects to itemize
Fact.Description: #37: Schedule A line 19: "If you elect to itemize deductions even though they are less than your standard deduction, check this box".

Fact.Name: Has unsupported itemized deductions
Fact.Description: #37 MVP scope screen: mortgage debt over $750,000 ($375,000 MFS) or interest not on Form 1098 (IRC §163(h)(3)(F), https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/26/163), investment interest (line 9), noncash gifts (line 12; Form 8283 over $500), carryovers (line 14), casualty and theft losses (line 16), other itemized deductions (line 17), other taxes (line 6), or foreign income excluded under §911/931/933 (MAGI for §164(b)(7)).

Fact.Name: Schedule A line 4 medical deduction
Fact.Description: #37: Schedule A (Form 1040) 2026 draft, https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-dft/f1040sa--dft.pdf p. 1, line 3 "Multiply line 2 by 7.5% (0.075)"; line 4 = line 1 minus line 3, not below zero. IRC §213(a) (https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/26/213): "to the extent that such expenses exceed 7.5 percent of adjusted gross income."

Fact.Name: Schedule A line 5d
Fact.Description: #37: Schedule A (Form 1040) 2026 draft, https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-dft/f1040sa--dft.pdf line 5d "Add lines 5a through 5c".

Fact.Name: SALT MAGI threshold
Fact.Description: #37: IRC §164(b)(7)(B)(ii)(II) as amended by P.L. 119-21 (https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/26/164): "in the case of any taxable year beginning in calendar year 2026, $505,000"; (B)(i): "half the threshold amount in the case of a married individual filing a separate return".

Fact.Name: SALT applicable limitation amount after phasedown
Fact.Description: #37: IRC §164(b)(7)(A)(ii): "$40,400" for 2026; (B)(i): "reduced by 30 percent of the excess (if any) of the taxpayer's modified adjusted gross income over the threshold amount"; (B)(iii): "shall not result in the applicable limitation amount being less than $10,000". MAGI = AGI here (no §911/931/933 exclusions; those knock out).

Fact.Name: SALT limit
Fact.Description: #37: IRC §164(b)(6)(B): "shall not exceed the applicable limitation amount (half the applicable limitation amount in the case of a married individual filing a separate return)". Gives $40,400 / $20,200 MFS (Schedule A 2026 draft line 5e) and a $10,000 / $5,000 MFS floor.

Fact.Name: Schedule A line 5e SALT deduction
Fact.Description: #37: Schedule A (Form 1040) 2026 draft, https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-dft/f1040sa--dft.pdf p. 1, line 5e: "Enter the smaller of line 5d or $40,400 ($20,200 if married filing separately). If Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 11b, is more than $505,000 ($252,500 if married filing separately) ... see instructions".

Fact.Name: Schedule A line 13 cash gifts after 0.5% floor
Fact.Description: #37: IRC §170(b)(1)(I) as added by P.L. 119-21 (https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/26/170): "shall be allowed only to the extent that the aggregate of such contributions exceeds 0.5 percent of the taxpayer's contribution base". Contribution base = AGI (no NOL carryback in scope). The 60% cash limit (§170(b)(1)(G)) is a knockout.

Fact.Name: Schedule A line 18 total itemized deductions
Fact.Description: #37: Schedule A (Form 1040) 2026 draft, https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-dft/f1040sa--dft.pdf line 18 (No branch): "Add the amounts in far-right column for lines 4 through 17z." MVP lines: 4, 5e, 8a (line 10), 13 (line 15).

Fact.Name: Itemizes deductions
Fact.Description: #37: itemize when Schedule A line 18 is more than the standard deduction, or when the filer elects to (line 19). IRC §63(e) (https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/26/63). Standard deduction: Rev. Proc. 2025-32 p. 18. #45: compared with the standard deduction plus the §170(p) line 12f amount, since that is only available without itemizing.

Fact.Name: Knockout: unsupported itemized deductions
Fact.Description: #37: yes to /scheduleAHasUnsupportedItems.

Fact.Name: Knockout: cash gifts over 60% of AGI
Fact.Description: #37: IRC §170(b)(1)(G)(i): cash gifts are allowed only up to "60 percent of the taxpayer's contribution base"; the limitation worksheet and carryover are out of MVP scope.

Fact.Name: Knockout: §68 overall limitation
Fact.Description: #37: Schedule A (Form 1040) 2026 draft, https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-dft/f1040sa--dft.pdf line 18: "Is the amount on Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 11b, minus the amounts on lines 13a and 13b of that form, more than $384,350? ... Yes. Your deductions may be limited." IRC §68(a) as amended (https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/26/68), 2/37 reduction. Not in MVP scope.
